summary: Three invoice rows, each its own context menu with a label, Open and Send reminder, and a 400 ms long-press delay for touch.
use: A menu per list row: each row is a focusable region, so keyboard users reach the same actions with Shift+F10.
spec: `{#each rows as row (row)}` renders `<ContextMenu class="cm-row" role="group" aria-label={row} longPressDelay={400}>` per row
The `menu` snippet starts with `<DropdownMenuLabel>{row}</DropdownMenuLabel>` and has Open and Send reminder items
Items set `last` to the action and the row name (Open or Send plus the invoice), shown under the list
